infrastructure: Slovenia has strong urban broadband and is expanding fibre infrastructure with EU cohesion funds.
Ljubljana has a small but modern data centre market.
5G deployment is progressing, with complete urban coverage expected by 2025.
talent: University of Ljubljana has an active Faculty of Computer and Information Science with AI research.
Slovenia's small population (2.1M) constrains the talent pool, but quality is relatively high.
Brain drain to Austria, Germany, and other Western EU countries is a challenge.
governance: Slovenia has a stable democratic system with strong rule of law and GDPR compliance.
The Information Commissioner's Office is an effective data protection regulator.
EU AI Act alignment is well-established within the national regulatory framework.
investment: Slovenia has notable tech companies (Celtra, Outfit7/My Talking Tom) demonstrating startup potential.
EU cohesion and innovation funds support SME digitalisation.
Domestic VC capacity is limited by small market size.
economic_readiness: A highly industrialised small economy with manufacturing and tourism sectors beginning AI adoption.
One of the higher GDP per capita nations in Eastern Europe, supporting enterprise AI demand.
Strong EU integration facilitates adoption of pan-European AI tools and platforms.
